reserveReview.reviewer: Grok phase1 reserve wave-8 2026-07-28; Kimi T59 re-review 2026-07-30
reserveReview.rationale: At HyperEVM block 40439370, the active Depositor accepted USDT0 while the reviewed Hyperbeat documentation also listed USDe and USR as broader or legacy inputs. The sources do not pin a current 60.5% hoUSDT / 39.5% masterUSD allocation or publish a durable constituent split, so hbUSDT is represented as one dynamic strategy envelope rather than an unsupported static snapshot. Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: Hyperbeat USDT vault docs still describe automated multi-strategy USDT vault with Accountable proof-of-solvency link; builder-code vault docs corroborate. Live strategy weights not dual-published as fixed composition → ku=100. Accountable dashboard returned 503 at write time. Write-time re-open 2026-07-30: Hyperbeat USDT vault docs still describe dynamic deployment of deposited assets into HyperEVM protocols with RockawayX risk oversight and publish no constituent or venue split; the Accountable proof-of-solvency dashboard returned HTTP 503 again at write time (also 503 on 2026-07-15 and 2026-07-28), so live strategy weights remain undisclosed and the single dynamic envelope with ku=100 stands.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Hyperbeat vault documentation, Accountable transparency, and fixed-block HyperEVM deposit-token review
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current strategy venues, position weights, look-through assets, and custody-provider shares are dynamic or undisclosed in the reviewed evidence.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The reviewed sources describe eligible inputs and a dynamic strategy product but do not support durable venue, asset, or position weights.

providers.name: Hyperbeat Insurance Contract and Redemption Contract

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Hyperbeat identifies on-chain insurance and redemption contracts and names Midas as the vault provider, but smart contracts are not legal custodians and the reviewed sources do not establish legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation terms, or current strategy-provider shares.
